principles: No credentials, source documents, extracted content, or catalog payloads in analytics
Stable event names and schema versions
Operational telemetry remains distinct from product analytics

events.name: workspace_onboarding_completed
events.trigger: Workspace completes required setup and reaches an import-capable state

events.name: import_job_started
events.trigger: Website or PDF import job is accepted

events.name: import_job_terminal
events.trigger: Import job succeeds, fails, or is canceled

events.name: discovery_session_reviewed
events.trigger: A user completes a discovery review action

events.name: catalog_item_created
events.trigger: Catalog item is created manually or promoted from discovery

events.name: ai_route_outcome
events.trigger: An AI capability route succeeds, falls back, or enters manual mode

metrics.name: onboarding_activation_rate
metrics.definition: Private-alpha workspaces completing onboarding and one successful catalog creation divided by invited workspaces.

metrics.name: import_success_rate
metrics.definition: Successful import jobs divided by terminal import jobs, segmented by source type.

metrics.name: candidate_to_catalog_conversion
metrics.definition: Candidates promoted to catalog divided by candidates reviewed.

metrics.name: manual_fallback_rate
metrics.definition: AI capability attempts ending in manual fallback divided by all AI capability attempts.

metrics.name: time_to_first_catalog_value
metrics.definition: Time from onboarding completion to first created catalog item.

analytics_risks.risk: Missing instrumentation prevents Stage 8 from distinguishing adoption problems from runtime failures.
analytics_risks.mitigation: Implement the minimal event catalog and validate dashboard source quality before private alpha.
analytics_risks.next_action: Select an analytics sink and privacy owner.

assumptions.assumption: Hashed workspace identifiers and coarse buckets are sufficient for private-alpha product measurement.
assumptions.next_action: Privacy and product owners approve the analytics data contract.
